messages:
maya: Heads up — after upgrading clusters in us-west1 to k8s 1.28 this morning, the cluster-autoscaler stopped scaling our GPU nodepools (gpupool-*)

oliver: Seeing the same in eu-west1. Pods pending with GPU requests, nodes not coming up. :eyes:

maya: Here's the autoscaler log snippet from one affected cluster:
```
I0307 09:12:45.123456 1 static_autoscaler.go:345] Successfully listed node groups
E0307 09:12:46.234567 1 scale_up.go:112] Failed to map node group for nodeGroupID: "projects/xxx/zones/us-west1-a/instanceGroupManagers/gpupool-xyz"
E0307 09:12:46.234589 1 utils.go:88] unable to parse nodegroup: unknown field 'instanceGroupManagers' in provider response
```

sam: Looks like the providerID / nodegroup path format changed in the node API after 1.28 for managed instance groups. The autoscaler shim expects the old path.

priya: Confirmed. The shim's GCE parser matches on `instanceGroup` but GKE 1.28 returns `instanceGroupManagers` in the node annotations for managed pools. Autoscaler 1.23 doesn't know that property.

maya: Workaround note — we added a node label on nodes in gpupool-* that the shim still matches on: `autoscaler.k8s.io/nodegroup=gpupool-xyz`. That made the autoscaler consider the group and trigger scale-up. Temporary but buys time.

oliver: Thanks. We patched the node bootstrap to add that label for new nodes in the interim. Existing pending pods consumed the free GPU slots in other regions, but several GPU jobs are stuck.

oncall: Cost note — gpu instances that should've been scaled down stayed on for ~3 hours during troubleshooting in us-west1, added roughly $1.9k to today's bill. Putting on the post-incident cost bucket.

maya: Root cause writeup: GKE k8s control-plane upgrade introduced a slightly different nodegroup metadata key for managed instance groups. Our cluster-autoscaler shim (internal fork) expects the legacy field -> failed to map nodegroups -> scale decisions skipped for all pools where mapping failed (mostly GPU pools).

sam: Proposed fix: patch the autoscaler shim to accept both `instanceGroup` and `instanceGroupManagers` paths, add unit test, bump the autoscaler image, roll out to control plane in a staged canary (start with non-prod clusters). I'll open a PR today.

priya: Also add a feature-flagged parser so we can toggle behavior per k8s version. Need backport to the 1.23 autoscaler branch we run in prod.

oliver: Can we also add a validation alert if the shim fails to map >N nodegroups in a cluster? This would have warned earlier.

maya: Good idea. I'll put an alert that fires when >5% of nodegroups are unmapped for >5m.

infra-bot: CI pipeline started for branch fix/autoscaler-gke1-28-compat (build #457).

sam: Quick mitigation plan we executed: 1) add `autoscaler.k8s.io/nodegroup` label on GPU nodes; 2) restart autoscaler deployment (no downtime); 3) patch bootstrap to label new nodes; 4) prepare PR for parser fix and tests.

priya: After the restart autoscaler detected the labeled groups and recovered scale-up for gpupool-usw. We still need the code fix because labeling is manual-op heavy and fragile.

maya: Filing follow-up infra ticket: INFRA-3421 (autoscaler: gce/gke nodegroup path compatibility). Assigning to @sam and @priya, priority: high.

oliver: One more gotcha — region constraints: some GPU quotas in eu-west1 blocked burst capacity during the outage. We should add per-region fallback routing in the scheduler plugin for long-running training jobs.

sam: Agreed. Add to the postmortem: consider cross-region leaky pool for non-latency sensitive GPU jobs.

maya: Timeline summary for record: 09:10 — k8s 1.28 rollout finished for control plane; 09:12 — autoscaler mapping errors start; 09:40 — manual labels + autoscaler restart; 10:05 — partial recovery; 11:00 — full recovery after bootstrap labels propagated and some jobs rescheduled.

oncall: If anyone didn't get the incident invite, I've added the calendar entry and will run the RCA session at 2pm PT.

priya: Postmortem owners: maya (write), sam (fix code), oliver (mitigations + quota plan).

maya: Thanks team. I'll paste the incident log and follow-ups into the ticket and the 2pm RCA. :+1:

oliver: LGTM.

infra-bot: Deployed hotfix image to staging cluster for validation (image: infra/autoscaler:1.23.6-hotfix). Test run scheduled at 12:30 PT.
